info.title: velixir
info.description: Velixir CLI - deploy any app to Velixir from the command line (source is built server-side with Nixpacks)

commands.name: apps
commands.description: List your apps

commands.name: cache
commands.description: Manage Valkey caches (run `velixir cache` for sub-commands)

commands.name: bind
commands.description:
Bind to an app (env var REDIS_URL by default; --env to override,
--format adonet for the StackExchange.Redis configuration form)

commands.name: connect
commands.description: Print connection string (format: url|adonet, default url)

commands.name: create
commands.description: Provision a new managed Valkey (Redis-compatible) cache

commands.name: delete
commands.description: Delete (confirms by re-typing the id unless --yes)

commands.name: list
commands.description: List caches on your team

commands.name: db
commands.description: Manage Postgres databases (run `velixir db` for sub-commands)

commands.name: bind
commands.description:
Bind to an app (env var DATABASE_URL by default; --env to override,
--format adonet for the Npgsql / EF Core keyword form)

options.name: --app
options.description:
Target app ID (overrides .velixir.json)
Link to an existing app instead of creating one

options.name: --slot
options.description: Target deployment slot (default: production)

options.name: --template
options.description: Deploy a starter template (nothing local needed)

options.name: --name
options.description: App name for a template deploy (default: the slug)

options.name: --with-services
options.description: Create + connect the database/cache a template uses

options.name: --no-services
options.description: Skip them (the app shows a setup page until one is bound)

options.name: --source-dir
options.description: Directory to package as source (default: current dir)

options.name: --no-tail
options.description: Enqueue the deploy and return without waiting for it

options.name: --key
options.description: API key, for CI and headless machines (skips the browser)

options.name: --no-browser
options.description: Paste a key at the prompt instead of approving in the browser

options.name: --url
options.description:
API base URL (default: https://velixir.net)
Environment variables (for CI/CD):
VELIXIR_API_KEY         API key
VELIXIR_APP_ID          Default app ID
VELIXIR_API_URL         API base URL
Getting started:
1. velixir doctor            (sanity-check your environment)
2. velixir login
3. velixir init              (creates app + .velixir.json)
4. velixir deploy            (upload source, build + deploy in one command)
Or if you already have an app:
1. velixir login
2. velixir init --app <id>   (links existing app)
3. velixir deploy
Docs: https://velixir.net/docs
